IDComponentType.description:
- UNKNOWN: UNKNOWN represents an unknown or uninitialized component type
 - MULTIPOOLER: MULTIPOOLER represents a multipooler component
 - MULTIGATEWAY: MULTIGATEWAY represents a multigateway component
 - MULTIORCH: MULTIORCH represents a multiorch component
IDComponentType.title: ComponentType represents the type of Multigres component

component.title: component identifies the type of Multigres component (multipooler, multigateway, or multiorch)

cell.title: cell is the Multigres cell where the component is located

name.description:
name is a unique identifier for the component within the multigres
cluster.

clustermetadataID.description: ID is a globally unique pooler identifier.

term.title: Current term, for candidate to update itself

accepted.title: True if the term was accepted

demoteLsn.description:
If this node was a primary and demoted itself, this contains the final LSN
before demotion. Standbys should replicate up to this point before switching
to a new primary. Empty if node was not a primary or didn't demote.

isHealthy.title: Whether Postgres is healthy and reachable

isEligible.title: Whether this pooler is eligible to be a leader

currentLsn.title:
For primary: current write position from pg_current_wal_lsn()
For standby: empty (use last_receive_lsn and last_replay_lsn instead)

lastReceiveLsn.title:
For standby: last WAL position received from pg_last_wal_receive_lsn()
For primary: empty

lastReplayLsn.title:
For standby: last WAL position replayed from pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()
For primary: empty

timestamp.title: Timestamp when this position was recorded

consensusdataWALPosition.title: WAL position for tracking replication state
